description: Repo hygiene (T1 item 10, issue #289; migrated to the klt --attest producer by issue #511). Raw-byte entries bind the audited bytes, including the audit narrative repo-hygiene.inventory.md itself; the ci.yml entry binds the canonical YAML parse of the signoff job only (sha256-canonical-yaml-v1, klayout-tools #5862), so comments, key reordering and edits outside jobs.signoff are not drift while a weakened gate still is. The audit findings and the append-only re-audit trail live in repo-hygiene.inventory.md.
